summary: First-principles design review, iteration 9, on the unified campaign branch (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_09.md). The headline claim, confirmatory family, and matching design were re-examined and stand; the statistics stack was RE-DERIVED from first principles rather than trusted — pass@k product form, rarefaction hypergeometric identity, exact sign-flip enumeration and its tie floor 2^(1+z-n), metric-time k* enforcement, the shared R5.2/R5.4 entropy threshold, and tau_sweep's partition-quantized grid with full-precision boundary handling — and NO defect was found in any estimator. Four real issues were found and fixed, all in the layer between the design and the GPU: (T1, major) the pre-registered confirmatory cell is defined by (arm, clustering, T, tau), and while R2.4 forced T onto the command line, tau=0 — the value the entire post-hoc tau ablation's 'superset run' premise rests on — was pinned in NO launch command, riding silently on the configs/branching.yaml default in both the campaign driver and the documented RESULTS SS5 reproduction command; fixed with explicit --entropy-threshold 0 on every treatment run, an R2.4 amendment requiring tau explicitness in parallel to its temperature clause (applied_09_explicit_tau_pin.md, tripwire-checked: adds an obligation discharged by same-iteration work, flips nothing), and a menu-wide pin test. (O1, moderate) On --resume the analyst decision numbering restarts at 1, so a stale decision_01.json from an interrupted campaign would be read as the fresh analyst's output if the new subprocess failed to write — the campaign could execute a spec nobody just chose and the R6.5 decision-artifact audit chain would carry one file with two meanings; fixed by archiving any pre-existing decision file to *.superseded before each analyst call, tested. (O2, moderate) ensure_servers demanded live vLLM+NLI before EVERY step including evals (Docker-only) and metrics/audit/sweep (pure post-processing), so a dead vLLM container after ~30h of completed runs would abort the campaign before computing metrics from artifacts already on disk; fixed with per-step needs_servers gating, tested menu-wide. (O3, the rehearsal question iteration 8 queued) the campaign's assembled state machine had never executed end-to-end — only component tests plus a dry-run print; closed with a mocked end-to-end pytest of main() itself (Phase A runs first and completely, the analyst is consulted only afterwards and only orders exploratory cells, stop ends the loop, state persists completion order, resume skips the completed Phase A preserving the R6.5 first-run pin, the STOP file aborts before any step, and server preflights fire exactly twice per spec), chosen over a --rehearse CLI flag to avoid adding production branches to the launcher right before launch. Also fixed a stale docstring pointer (adaptive disclosure is RESULTS SS2.2, not SS6). Iteration 8's other queued checks came back clean: no doc/test references campaign-absent paths; RESULTS.md is internally consistent end-to-end (command chain, control-dir naming, port 8001 wiring). 117 tests pass (111 -> 117, +6 new), py_compile clean, campaign dry-run prints the correct plan including the tau pin; work committed (55dc610). Because this iteration found and fixed real issues (one major), gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; the loop should make one more pass — if fresh eyes on a branch whose last delta touched only the launcher find nothing substantive, the remaining actions are human-only (amendment ratification + GPU launch).

R1_faithfulness.notes: Unchanged this iteration; tau gate key re-verified at both call sites while auditing the tau-pin fix.

R3_ablations.notes: The post-hoc sweep's validity precondition (superset run) is now enforced at the command layer, not assumed from a YAML default.

R4_metrics_independent.notes: No defect found in any estimator under from-scratch re-derivation; signature-based diversity remains independent of the branching NLI (non-circular H1).

R5_uncertainty_analysis.notes: Strata/off-mode remain descriptive at n=10 with pre-committed reading rules; nothing changed or needed changing.

R6_statistical_rigor.evidence: paired_permutation_pvalue exact at n<=20 with min_achievable_sign_flip_p floor (both re-derived); R6.5 adaptive boundary + first-run pin now also execution-tested (test_campaign_resume_skips_completed_phase_a); decision-artifact integrity fixed (stale-file archiving, test_stale_decision_file_never_read_as_fresh)
R6_statistical_rigor.notes: O1 was an R6.5 audit-chain hole: a stale decision file could masquerade as a fresh scheduling decision. Closed structurally before any data exist.

R7_reproducibility.notes: A dead vLLM container can no longer block pure post-processing steps on resume (O2).

issues_found.title: The pre-registered confirmatory cell's tau=0 (the superset premise of the entire post-hoc tau ablation) appeared in NO launch command — both the campaign driver and the documented RESULTS SS5 command inherited it silently from configs/branching.yaml, the exact silent-config-default failure mode R2.4 forbids for temperature
issues_found.rationale: The cell is defined by (arm, clustering, T, tau); a config edit between cells would corrupt the tau sweep with no loud failure. Pinned --entropy-threshold 0 on every treatment run + RESULTS SS5; R2.4 amended in parallel to its temperature clause (applied_09_explicit_tau_pin.md); menu-wide test.

issues_found.title: On --resume, a stale decision_<n>.json from an interrupted campaign could be read as the fresh analyst call's output (numbering restarts at 1), executing a spec nobody just chose and corrupting the R6.5 decision-artifact audit chain
issues_found.rationale: Archive any pre-existing decision file to *.superseded before invoking the analyst; only a freshly written file is ever validated. Tested with a subprocess stub that writes nothing.

issues_found.title: ensure_servers required live vLLM+NLI before every step, including evals (Docker-only) and metrics/audit/sweep (pure post-processing) — a dead vLLM container after the runs would abort the campaign before computing metrics from artifacts already on disk
issues_found.rationale: Per-step needs_servers flag, set only on the two agent-run steps; menu-wide test plus preflight-count assertion in the e2e test.

issues_found.title: The campaign's assembled state machine (Phase A ordering, analyst gating, stop/resume/STOP semantics, state persistence) had never been executed end-to-end — only component unit tests and a dry-run print (iteration 8's open rehearsal question)
issues_found.rationale: Mocked end-to-end pytest of main() itself; rejected a --rehearse CLI flag because it would add production branches to the launcher immediately before launch for marginal extra realism (rationale in scrutiny_09 SS3).

issues_found.title: Campaign docstring pointed the adaptive-execution disclosure at RESULTS.md SS6; it lives in SS2.2
issues_found.rationale: One-line pointer fix; found during the iter-8-queued end-to-end consistency re-read, which found nothing else inconsistent.
